Jupiter transits Cancer until ~30 June 2026, then enters Leo (~30 Jun / 1 Jul 2026) through 2027. A Cancer Sun gets the 'Jupiter in its own sign' backdrop ONLY for the group stage (Jun 11-30); the July knockouts have Jupiter in Leo.

Saturn is in Aries 2025-2028 (a cardinal sign of fresh starts / earned thresholds). Capricorn is ruled by Saturn (traditional ruler) -> a Capricorn Sun reads through Saturn's discipline/structure regardless of where Saturn currently transits.

Sun sign is NOT the chart ruler. Footballers' birth TIMES are generally unrecorded, so Moon sign, Ascendant, and house placements are UNVERIFIED -> say so explicitly and do NOT fabricate them. Anchor the reading on the Sun sign + verifiable facts.
Astrology here is strictly symbolic and educational. Never predict match results, never claim astrology determines outcomes, never give betting guidance. (Also satisfies 广告法 for the ZH pass.)
Transits time year-level themes, not fixtures. Do NOT claim a transit-to-natal aspect predicts a specific match.
